response.description: Packet capture is meant to capture specific flows for customers which can be filtered based on protocol, flags and filters. Packet captures can be initiated via a portal experience or via code using PowerShell.Learn more:For more information on how to use packet capture, see Troubleshoot Azure Firewall using Packet capture | Microsoft Learnfor a walkthrough on how to use the feature with examples of captures of various flows see Deep Dive into Network Troubleshooting with Azure Firewall’s Packet Capture | Microsoft Tech Community
response.title: Generally Available: Troubleshoot Azure Firewall using packet capture
